title: Graph Valid Tree
statement:
Given an integer n representing the number of nodes in a graph and a list of edges, determine whether the given edges form a valid tree.

A valid tree must satisfy two conditions:
1. It is a connected graph (all nodes are reachable from any node)
2. It contains no cycles (it is acyclic)

Equivalently, a tree with n nodes has exactly n-1 edges and is fully connected.

visibleExamples.explanation: The edges form a connected tree with 5 nodes and 4 edges.
The edges form a cycle (0-1-2-3-1), so it is not a valid tree.
Two nodes connected by a single edge form a valid tree.
